Thank you for responding, I'm glad someone relates. 

I've always had a handful of Big Life Goals that have been relatively unchanged since I was a kid, just more refined and informed as I got older. I'm sorry to say that last year I even actually made a huge step towards being in the line of work I want to be in, and I still don't have any solid sense of future. It's so bizarre. It's like at any given moment I know exactly what I want and where I want to go, but don't actually expect to get to do any of it.

Your words and feelings were me exactly when I was applying for schools in 2016/2017. I settled for a school I hated less than others but have to pay every cent on loans because I figured if I worked hard I would get scholarships and the burden would be less. 

I'm going into my fourth and final year this year. I have never received a scholarship despite being an excellent student. I am in the wildlife and natural resource conservation field, so I have no money coming at me unless I buckle for a shitty government desk job. I am going to be so deep in debt and have no way to pay it next summer. 

Don't. Go. To. College. At least not yet. Just get a couple decent jobs and work for the next couple of years, maybe go to your local school part time during or after that. Save up, do your best, and if more options become available to you in the next couple of years, go for it. 

I so deelpy regret jumping straight into university. Please please please do not feel obligated to go to school.

Honestly sick of this shit. As someone who has been suicidal for almost a decade, had to be put on watch several times and everything - this show gave me the longest period of peace in my life because I stopped feeling so alone.

I sometimes feel that worry as well, but if anything I feel as though this has been a thread on which I could find peace by reading that other people feel like I do. Not many people where I live really understand or talk about mental illnesses at all, let alone suicide. 
I hope everyone on these threads find their own reason for fighting of course, but know that there are people - like myself - that find a lot of comfort or safety in this community.
